rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user by matching full name and zip to a single account and identified the relevant pending laptop order. However, it violated key policy steps: (1) It executed order-changing writes without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit confirmation—for both the laptop spec change and the wristwatch variant change. (2) It inaccurately claimed the NYC address was in the user profile; the profile address (per get_user_details) is in Houston, while the NYC address appears only on a delivered order. (3) It attempted to update the shipping address without confirmation and then reported inability due to order status. Although transferring to a human agent after the address-change failure was appropriate, the earlier policy breaches (lack of pre-change confirmation and an unsupported statement about the address) mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
